name: MEGMILK SNOW BRAND Co.,Ltd.
summary: MEGMILK SNOW BRAND Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of milk, milk products, and other food products in Japan and internationally. It operates through Dairy Products, Beverages and Desserts, and Feed Seeds segments. The company offers processed and natural cheese, condensed and skim milk, butter, powdered milk, and margarine; nutrition products, including infant formula and functional food; and other products. It also provides milk and milk beverages, yogurt, fruit and vegetable juice, soft drinks, and desserts; and infant formula and functional food.
